description: This Java class 'ImageLoader' manages asynchronous image loading with caching, placeholder handling, fade-in effects, and background processing, used within an Android application.

classes.name: ImageLoader
classes.description: Abstract class for asynchronously loading images with caching and fade-in effects in Android.

classes.name: AsyncDrawable
classes.description: Custom drawable that holds a reference to the background image loading task.

classes.name: BitmapWorkerTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass that performs image processing in the background.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image into an ImageView, using cache if available, or starting background processing.

methods.name: setLoadingImage
methods.description: Sets a placeholder image shown while loading.

methods.name: addImageCache
methods.description: Adds an image cache instance for caching bitmaps.

methods.name: setImageFadeIn
methods.description: Enables or disables fade-in effect when images are loaded.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromDescriptor
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from a file descriptor to specified dimensions.

methods.name: calculateInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates the appropriate sample size for downsampling images based on requested dimensions.
